{{Quote|Well, they took my cargo ship.|Morlimur Snugg|<ref name="Revival (episode)">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''ALC-9''' was an [[YV-865 Aurore-class freighter/Legends|YV-865 ''Aurore''-class freighter]] owned by the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Morlimur Snugg/Legends|Morlimur Snugg]], the [[Superintendent/Legends|Superintendent]] of the [[Cybloc Transfer Station/Legends|Cybloc Transfer Station]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was stolen by the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].
